visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short, dark hair and fair skin is positioned in the center, wearing a strapless patterned top and a delicate silver necklace. She smiles softly at the camera, tilting her head slightly, showcasing a pink-toned makeup look with shimmering eyes and glossy lips. The background is a clean, neutral studio setting with soft, diffused lighting that highlights her features. (2) The scene shifts to a product showcase, displaying three Dior blush palettes in silver cases with transparent lids showing pink and red shades. A close-up shows the woman's arm with three horizontal swatches of pink blush, labeled with numbers. She is then seen holding a blush palette and applying the powder to her cheek with a soft makeup brush, smiling as she blends. (3) Three pink lipstick tubes are presented vertically on a surface. Swatches of these shades are shown on the woman's forearm in a similar manner to the blush. She applies the lipstick directly to her cheek for demonstration, then uses her finger to blend it onto her lips, maintaining a bright and playful expression. (4) Three tubes of lip glow butter in pink, purple, and red are shown. After arm swatches are displayed, she holds a pink tube and applies the product to her lips while looking into a small handheld mirror, finishing with a close-up of her hydrated, glossy lips. (5) In the final sequence, the woman poses with the completed makeup look, holding a small white long-haired dog close to her face. She smiles and pouts at the camera, showing off the rosy glow of her makeup. The video concludes with an artistic arrangement of all the Dior products used throughout the tutorial.
